title: Soviet divers meet tall humanoids at Lake Baikal

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up a story from 1982 about Soviet divers at Lake Baikal, a huge deep lake in Siberia. As he tells it, the divers went down looking for something and met very tall human-like beings under the water. If true, it would mean something not human was living or working beneath the lake.
